html:
Preventive Care with Full Body Health Checkups at Silver Touch Hospitals

When it comes to your health, early detection is everything.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, our full body health checkup packages are designed to identify potential issues before they become serious problems. Whether you’re managing an existing condition or simply want peace of mind, a routine checkup can offer clarity, control, and confidence.

Our health check up in Ahmedabad includes key blood tests, radiology studies, cardiac checks, and organ functions, all performed by skilled experts with state-of-the-art diagnostic facilities.

Why Select Us for a Full Body Checkup in Ahmedabad?

Silver Touch Hospitals is a major multispeciality clinic providing thorough health checkup packages for men, women, and seniors.

Each test is performed within a clean, hospital-grade environment, both accurate and safe for the patient.

Our packages consist of:

  • Complete blood count and metabolic profile
  • Liver function tests and kidney function tests
  • Lipid profile and screening for diabetes
  • Thyroid function tests
  • ECG, 2D Echo, and Treadmill Test
  • Chest X-ray and abdominal ultrasonography
  • Analysis of urine and stool

You will also be given a one-to-one consultation with a doctor to review your findings and follow-up steps, if any.

The Smart Choice for Health Check Up in Ahmedabad

A good health check up in Ahmedabad should not be hasty or cursory. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we attend to accuracy, patient confidentiality, and prompt reporting. You won’t be made to wait forever or be referred to several clinics; it all gets done under one roof, with same-day or next-day reports for the majority of packages.We also have personalised add-ons depending on age, family history, or current symptoms.

The Best Full Body Checkup Hospital in Ahmedabad - Silver Touch Hospitals

Selecting the best hospital for full body checkup in Ahmedabad is about putting your trust in a team that is serious about prevention. With certified doctors, skilled lab technicians, and in-house radiology, Silver Touch Hospitals offers reliable insights into your health.

This is not a sequence of tests; it’s an investment in your long-term health.

Do you need a full body checkup in Ahmedabad? Contact your nearest Silver Touch Hospitals, today.

faqs.q: How long does the full body checkup last?
faqs.a: The majority of checkups take 2 to 3 hours. Reports are typically made available within 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.q: Do I need to fast before the tests?
faqs.a: Yes, 10–12 hours of fasting is advised for obtaining correct results, particularly for blood sugar and lipid profile investigations.

faqs.q: Is the checkup covered by insurance?
faqs.a: Preventive health checkups may be covered under some corporate or mediclaim policies. We can assist with providing the required documents for reimbursement.
Yes. According to your age, gender, and health history, our staff can include certain tests as required.
